exposure: Cardiac Disease in Pregnancy II (CARPREG II)
cohort: The study included 333 pregnant women with cardiac diseases (163 congenital and 170 acquired) who delivered at Songklanagarind Hospital between January 1, 2011, and December 31, 2022, excluding pregnancies ending before 24 weeks.
finding: CARPREG II demonstrated the highest predictive performance for cardiac events in pregnant women with all cardiac diseases, while ZAHARA exhibited the lowest predictive performance for congenital cardiac diseases.
